ex.en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。

ex.en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
ex.zh: 在这个房间里，你想坐哪儿都行。

ex.en: Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.
ex.zh: 可靠的网络连接使员工能够在任何地方工作，减少了每天通勤的必要。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

senses.zh: 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；奇妙的；美妙；胜；神妙

ex.en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。

ex.en: Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆为儿童发现新兴趣提供了极好的机会，又不会给家庭带来经济压力。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

senses.zh: 不少；还不少；有相当数目的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1

senses.zh: 大部分的，多数的；最多的

ex.en: Most shops here close before we finish work.
ex.zh: 这里大多数商店在我们下班前就关门了。

ex.en: Most urban residents would benefit from reliable public transport that connects residential areas with major employment centres.
ex.zh: 大多数城市居民都会受益于连接住宅区与主要就业中心的可靠公共交通。

col: most of the time｜大部分时间
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。泛指用most people；特指用most of the people。

senses.zh: 重要的人；值得重视的事

ex.en: There is something soft inside this little box.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。

ex.en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
ex.zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

ex.en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
ex.zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。

ex.en: Without affordable public transport, some residents have nothing to rely on except their own cars.
ex.zh: 如果没有价格合理的公共交通，一些居民除了自己的汽车便无可依靠。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。
📘 8A Unit 1

senses.zh: 我自己；我亲自；我的正常的健康状况和正常情绪

ex.en: I made myself a sandwich before the walk.
ex.zh: 散步前，我给自己做了个三明治。

ex.en: By volunteering at a community garden, I taught myself practical skills that formal education rarely provides.
ex.zh: 通过在社区花园做志愿者，我自学了正规教育很少传授的实用技能。

col: not feel myself｜感觉不在状态
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。by myself表示独自或独立；不能用myself代替主语I。

ex.en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
ex.zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。

ex.en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
ex.zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。对应单数you；对多人说“你们自己”用yourselves。

senses.zh: 你们自己；你们本人（yourself的复数）

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1
📘 8A Unit 1

ex.en: A pink pig was sleeping beside the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 一头粉色的猪正睡在木栅栏旁。

ex.en: Farmers can improve animal welfare by giving pigs enough space to move freely and explore.
ex.zh: 农民可以给猪足够的自由活动和探索空间，以改善动物福利。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。

ex.en: You seem tired after your long walk home.
ex.zh: 你走了那么远的路回家，看起来很累。

ex.en: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
ex.zh: 尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。
📘 8A Unit 1

ex.en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。

ex.en: Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
ex.zh: 如果有信任的人可以倾听他们的困扰，学生求助时可能会更有信心。

col: someone to talk to｜可以倾诉的人
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

senses.zh: 快乐的；有乐趣的；令人愉快的

ex.en: The cooking class was enjoyable, especially making fresh pasta.
ex.zh: 这堂烹饪课很有趣，尤其是制作新鲜意面的时候。

ex.en: Making physical activity enjoyable can encourage children to develop healthy habits that continue into adulthood.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童养成延续至成年的健康习惯。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。形容活动令人愉快用 enjoyable，不用 enjoyed。

ex.en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，我最喜欢的活动是画画。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以改善心理健康，并降低患多种慢性疾病的风险。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。

ex.en: We decided to walk home after the film.
ex.zh: 看完电影后，我们决定走路回家。

ex.en: Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定如何在医疗、教育和公共交通之间分配有限资源。

col: decide to do something｜决定做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。用decide to do，不用decide doing。

senses.zh: 试图，努力；试验；审判；考验

ex.en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
ex.zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。

ex.en: Schools should try different teaching methods to meet the needs of students with varying abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应尝试不同的教学方法，以满足能力各异的学生的需求。

col: try to do something｜努力做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

senses.zh: 高崖跳伞运动；滑翔伞运动

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1
📘 8A Unit 1

ex.en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。

ex.en: Protecting native bird species requires preserving their habitats and reducing pollution in both rural and urban areas.
ex.zh: 保护本土鸟类需要维护其栖息地，并减少乡村和城市地区的污染。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在那家小面包店外面。

ex.en: Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.
ex.zh: 骑自行车出行既能减少城市空气污染，也能让居民经常锻炼身体。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。by bicycle不加冠词；ride a bicycle要加冠词。

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

ex.en: A market trader arranged fresh oranges outside his stall.
ex.zh: 一位市场商贩在摊位外摆放新鲜橙子。

ex.en: Small traders often struggle to compete with larger retailers that can negotiate lower prices from suppliers.
ex.zh: 小商贩往往难以与能向供应商争取更低价格的大型零售商竞争。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。可指实物买卖者，也可指金融市场交易员。

ex.en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
ex.zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。

ex.en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
ex.zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.zh: 顶部，顶端；上部；首席；陀螺
超越，超过；给…加盖；达到…的顶端
高出，超越；结束；达到顶点

ex.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
ex.zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
ex.zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

ex.en: Please wait here while I find my keys.
ex.zh: 请在这里等一下，我去找钥匙。

ex.en: Patients in rural areas often wait longer for specialist treatment because local medical services are limited.
ex.zh: 由于当地医疗服务有限，农村地区的患者往往需要等待更久才能接受专科治疗。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。等人用wait for someone；等着做用wait to do。

senses.zh: 雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构

ex.en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
ex.zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。

ex.en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
ex.zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

ex.en: My socks got wet when I stepped in a puddle.
ex.zh: 我踩进水坑，把袜子弄湿了。

ex.en: Prolonged wet weather can damage crops and make it harder for farmers to harvest them efficiently.
ex.zh: 持续的阴雨天气会损害庄稼，使农民更难高效收获。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。damp指微湿；soaking wet表示湿透。
📘 8A Unit 1

senses.zh: 在下面，在较低处；在本页下面

ex.en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
ex.zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。

ex.en: Households with incomes below the national average may struggle to afford adequate heating during winter.
ex.zh: 收入低于全国平均水平的家庭可能难以负担冬季充足供暖的费用。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

ex.en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
ex.zh: 我们的米够今晚所有人吃。

ex.en: Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.
ex.zh: 许多农村学校缺乏足够的资源，无法为学生开设广泛的课程。

col: enough to eat｜足够吃的东西
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。修饰名词放前面，修饰形容词或副词放后面。

senses.zh: 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的

ex.en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
ex.zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。

ex.en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助饥饿的孩子集中课堂注意力，更积极地参与学习。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。

senses.zh: 因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时

ex.en: She works as a guide at the local museum.
ex.zh: 她在当地博物馆担任讲解员。

ex.en: As public transport becomes more reliable, fewer commuters may choose to drive to work.
ex.zh: 随着公共交通变得更加可靠，选择开车上班的通勤者可能会减少。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。as表示实际身份；like表示相似。重读时读/æz/。

ex.en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
ex.zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。

ex.en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
ex.zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

senses.zh: 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分

ex.en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
ex.zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。

ex.en: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
ex.zh: 拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

ex.en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。

ex.en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
ex.zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。

col: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事
a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感
take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

senses.zh: 中央公园；纽约中央公园；中心公园

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1

senses.zh: 中国香港；香港特别行政区；中国香港特别行政区

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1

ex.en: We explored a rainforest during our holiday in Malaysia.
ex.zh: 我们在马来西亚度假期间探索了一片热带雨林。

ex.en: Tourism in Malaysia creates employment opportunities, but protecting fragile coastal ecosystems remains an important priority.
ex.zh: 马来西亚的旅游业创造了就业机会，但保护脆弱的沿海生态系统仍是一项重要任务。

col: travel to Malaysia｜前往马来西亚旅行
Peninsular Malaysia｜马来西亚半岛地区
tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。国名首字母大写，通常不加冠词the。

senses.zh: 马来西亚的；马来西亚人的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1

senses.zh: 天安门广场；周年联欢晚会；天安门广场夜景

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。

ex.en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 1。表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

ex.en: We share the housework so nobody spends Sunday cleaning alone.
ex.zh: 我们分担家务，这样就没人需要独自在周日打扫了。

ex.en: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
ex.zh: 公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。不可数，不能说a housework；做家务用do。

ex.en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

ex.en: Have you ever watched the sunrise from a mountain?
ex.zh: 你曾经在山上看过日出吗？

ex.en: Public transport is more important than ever as growing cities struggle with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 随着不断扩张的城市面临交通拥堵和空气污染，公共交通比以往任何时候都更重要。

col: more than ever｜比以往任何时候都更
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。问经历常用Have you ever…；肯定句不随意代替always。

senses.zh: 几乎不；几乎从不；几乎从来不

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2

ex.en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
ex.zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。

ex.en: Once reliable public transport becomes available, more commuters may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 一旦有了可靠的公共交通，更多通勤者可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。once引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

ex.en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
ex.zh: 我检查了两次包，却没找到钥匙。

ex.en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 每周至少锻炼两次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。两倍常用twice as…as或twice the＋名词。

senses.en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.

ex.en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
ex.zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。

ex.en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

senses.zh: 用程序指令；为…制订计划；为…安排节目
编程序；安排节目；设计电脑程式

ex.en: This program helps me organise all my holiday photos.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮我整理所有度假照片。

ex.en: Schools should teach students how to program computers rather than simply how to use existing software.
ex.zh: 学校应教学生如何给计算机编程，而不只是如何使用现有软件。

col: program a computer｜给计算机编程
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

ex.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
ex.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

ex.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
ex.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

col: launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

senses.zh: 完全的，完整的；满的，充满的；丰富的；完美的；丰满的；详尽的

ex.en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
ex.zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。

ex.en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

senses.zh: 摇摆；摆动；秋千；音律；涨落
旋转的；悬挂的；强节奏爵士音乐的
摇摆；转向；悬挂；大摇大摆地行走

ex.en: Her bag swung gently as she walked down the street.
ex.zh: 她走在街上，包随着步伐轻轻摆动。

ex.en: A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
ex.zh: 公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。

col: swing back and forth｜来回摆动
a swing in public opinion｜舆论转变
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。

senses.zh: 摇摆舞；摇摆舞蹈；於摇摆舞

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2

ex.en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
ex.zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。

ex.en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
ex.zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。maybe是副词；may be是情态动词加be。

senses.zh: 最小的；最少的（little的最高级）

ex.en: This soup needs the least salt of all.
ex.zh: 这些汤里，这道汤需要的盐最少。

ex.en: Public transport often causes the least pollution per passenger when compared with private car travel.
ex.zh: 与私家车出行相比，公共交通的人均污染通常最少。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。
📘 8A Unit 2
📘 8A Unit 2

senses.zh: 垃圾食物；没有营养的食品；没有营养的垃圾食品

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2

ex.en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。

col: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

ex.en: Walking to work has really improved my health.
ex.zh: 步行上班确实改善了我的健康状况。

ex.en: Governments can improve public health by providing safe drinking water and affordable access to medical services.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供安全饮用水和可负担的医疗服务来改善公众健康。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.zh: 结果；成绩；答案；比赛结果

ex.en: The shiny floor was the result of hours of cleaning.
ex.zh: 这光亮的地板是花了好几个小时打扫的成果。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can result in lower emissions and shorter commuting times for urban residents.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通，可以减少排放并缩短城市居民的通勤时间。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.zh: 百分比，百分率；部分；百分数

ex.en: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
ex.zh: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。

ex.en: Nearly forty percent of surveyed residents supported investing more public money in cycling infrastructure.
ex.zh: 近百分之四十的受访居民支持将更多公共资金投入自行车基础设施。

col: a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。
📘 8A Unit 2

ex.en: I booked our train tickets online after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我在网上订了我们的火车票。

ex.en: Online courses can widen access to education, especially for learners who live far from universities.
ex.zh: 网络课程可以扩大受教育的机会，尤其有利于远离大学的学习者。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

ex.en: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们在电视上看了一档野生动物节目。

ex.en: Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.
ex.zh: 教育类电视节目可以让儿童接触难以在课堂上演示的科学概念。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。watch television不加冠词；指一台电视机用a television。

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是走回了家。

ex.en: Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源需要大量前期投资，但从长远来看，它能降低电力成本。

col: although it is true that｜虽然确实……
although not always｜虽然并非总是
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.zh: 理智，精神；意见；智力；记忆力

ex.en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
ex.zh: 你介意离开前把窗户关上吗？

ex.en: Regular physical activity can benefit both the body and the mind by reducing stress and improving concentration.
ex.zh: 规律的体育活动能减轻压力、提高专注力，从而有益于身心健康。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。表示介意做某事用mind doing，不用mind to do。

senses.zh: 身体；主体；大量；团体；主要部分

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
ex.zh: 昨天走了很长一段路，现在我全身酸痛。

ex.en: An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.
ex.zh: 应由一个独立机构监测水质，并向公众公布调查结果。

col: a body of evidence｜一系列证据
the body of an essay｜文章正文
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。body可指机构；文章的body指正文部分。

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
ex.zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。

ex.en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

senses.zh: 例如；像；象…这样；诸如…之类
比如；像这种的；像……那样的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2

senses.zh: 新潮的；情绪稳定的，做事有效率的
一起；同时；相互；连续地；总共

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

ex.en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
ex.zh: 如果忘了浇水，这些植物就会枯死。

ex.en: Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.
ex.zh: 许多海洋动物吞食塑料垃圾后死亡，这凸显了减少海洋污染的迫切需要。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

ex.en: The writer filled her notebook while waiting for the train.
ex.zh: 那位作家等火车时，把笔记本写得满满的。

ex.en: A skilled writer can make complex environmental issues accessible to readers without oversimplifying the scientific evidence.
ex.zh: 优秀的作者能让读者理解复杂的环境问题，同时不过度简化科学证据。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。writer范围较广；author常指某部作品的作者。

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
ex.zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。

ex.en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。

col: a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

ex.en: She bought a gardening magazine at the station.
ex.zh: 她在车站买了一本园艺杂志。

ex.en: A specialist magazine can provide practical career advice that general news websites may not offer.
ex.zh: 专业杂志可以提供综合新闻网站未必能提供的实用职业建议。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。可数名词；英式重音通常在末音节，美式在首音节。

senses.zh: 无论以何种方式; 不管怎样
无论如何；不管怎样（接副词或形容词）；然而；可是

ex.en: The jacket looked warm; however, it felt surprisingly thin.
ex.zh: 这件夹克看起来很暖和，摸起来却出奇地薄。

ex.en: Online courses offer greater flexibility; however, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 在线课程更加灵活；不过，有些学习者从与教师的直接互动中获益更多。

col: however hard you try｜无论你多努力
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

senses.zh: 比（用于形容词、副词的比较级之后）；除…外（用于other等之后）；与其…（用于 rather等之后）；一…就（用于 no sooner等之后）

ex.en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
ex.zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。

ex.en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。
📘 8A Unit 2

ex.en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。

ex.en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

senses.zh: 没有人；一个也没有；没有任何东西

ex.en: I checked the biscuit tin, but there were none left.
ex.zh: 我看了看饼干罐，但一块也没剩下。

ex.en: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
ex.zh: 虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。

col: none other than｜正是；不是别人而是
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。none可独立用；修饰名词用no，如no books。

ex.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
ex.zh: 这次请在我的茶里少放点糖。

ex.en: Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.
ex.zh: 家庭可以通过改善隔热措施和选用更节能的电器来减少能源消耗。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。
📘 8A Unit 2

senses.zh: 要点；得分；标点； 尖端

ex.en: You made a good point about sharing the kitchen.
ex.zh: 关于共用厨房，你说得很有道理。

ex.en: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

senses.en: To take legal action against someone, usually seeking compensation.

ex.en: Our neighbour plans to sue the builder over faulty repairs.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居打算因维修质量问题起诉那名建筑工人。

ex.en: Consumers should have the right to sue companies that knowingly sell unsafe products or conceal serious defects.
ex.zh: 消费者应有权起诉明知产品不安全仍销售，或隐瞒严重缺陷的公司。

col: sue for damages｜起诉要求损害赔偿
sue for negligence｜因过失提起诉讼
tip: 📘 8A Unit 2。sue someone for something：因某事起诉某人。

senses.zh: 对人友好的，开朗的；出发的，外出的；即将离职的；乐于助人的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.zh: 长辈；较好者；打赌的人（等于bettor）
更好的；更多的；较大程度地

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
ex.zh: 这个背包比我原来的那个好。

ex.en: Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 更好的公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市的就业可达性。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。是good和well的比较级，不说more better。

ex.en: Everyone cheered loudly when our team won the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛时，大家都大声欢呼。

ex.en: Passengers who speak loudly on public transport can disturb others, particularly during early morning or late evening journeys.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上大声说话的乘客会打扰他人，尤其是在清晨或深夜的行程中。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。loudly强调音量大；aloud强调出声而非默读。

ex.en: Please close the door quietly; the baby is sleeping.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，宝宝正在睡觉。

ex.en: Students who work quietly in shared study areas help create an environment that supports concentration.
ex.zh: 在公共学习区域安静学习的学生有助于营造利于专注的环境。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。quietly是副词；注意别与quite（相当）混淆。
📘 8A Unit 3

ex.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
ex.zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。
